notes: z_idle_threads is an array, one per CPU; only the first is named here, because its stride is sizeof(struct k_thread) and that is not something the symbol table states
threads created with k_thread_create() into a plain `static struct k_thread` have no distinguishing symbol and are absent here by design; they render as raw pointers rather than as a guess
no _sw_isr_table in the ELF (CONFIG_GEN_SW_ISR_TABLE=n, or an architecture that does not use one): ISR records carry their raw vector number and resolve to no name
